FIX 1 (research escalation) — owner one-liner: in .github/workflows/research-agent.yml add `allowed_bots: "github-actions[bot]"` alongside `claude_code_oauth_token:` in the claude-code-action steps. Escalations only run the deep tier, so the two DEEP-tier steps (Fable-5 preferred + Opus-4.8 fallback) are load-bearing; adding it to the standard step too is harmless and consistent. Prefer the specific bot over `"*"`: this is a PUBLIC repo and the explicit list is more defensible (workflow_dispatch already requires write access, so no external bot can dispatch). Scheduled/manual runs have a User actor for whom allowed_bots is ignored, so the change is safe for the currently-passing schedule path. If "github-actions[bot]" does not match the action's compare convention, the guaranteed fallback per the action's own error text is `allowed_bots: "*"`.
